notes: No ครับ, ค่ะ, คะ, ผม or ดิฉัน anywhere; i18n:check fails on them. First-person labels the player taps use ฉัน; พวกเขา is the plural for squads.
No spaces between words; one space around numbers, number placeholders, Latin words and name placeholders, and between sentences. No sentence-final full stop except text.period.
Generated names are noun-first with no space (generatedNames: noun-first-joined): ยอดเขา + สายฟ้า = ยอดเขาสายฟ้า, ใบมีด + แฝด = ใบมีดแฝด.
Intl.ListFormat for Thai attaches และ/หรือ to the next item; locales/runtime.ts listFormat adds the space Thai needs before a number or Latin word (12,000 เหรียญและ 2,400 เสบียง).
Dates use the Buddhist-era year that Intl gives for th (พ.ศ. 2569), the Thai convention.
Computer players' generated names (Kaito Mori) are stored text and stay in Latin letters, as in every language.
